issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

url.description: The c3server {@link AppUrl} with protocol prefix.

exMachinaClientUrl.description:
The url for the `exMachinaClient` application for features like Stories. An associated VanityUrl should be created
that matches this url and it needs to have `contentRoot` set to `exMachinaClient`.

airbrakeProjectId.description: The project id for Airbrake error reporting

airbrakeProjectKey.description: The project key for Airbrake error reporting

pendoApiKey.description:
The API key for Pendo usage tracking. Per the documentation for the `pendo` package, this should typically be
defined in {@link PendoConfig}, but Ex Machina could potentially be run in an environment where different API keys
are desired for inside vs. outside Visual Analytics Designer (VAD) iframe. For stand-alone Ex Machina deployments
(deployments of the `standAloneExMachina` package), the {@link PendoConfig.apiKey} _must also_ be set to allow
tracking in the Ex Machina Management context as well as the VAD iframe. However, for customer deployments that
leverage the `exMachinaUi` package and/or deployments through IDS, the {@link PendoConfig.apiKey} may be
set to something more applicable to the parent application in order to track non-Ex Machina usage more generically.
In this case, this `pendoApiKey` should be set specifically for tracking usage within the VAD iframe.

accountAddressConfidenceIndicatorThredsh.description:
The account address confidence indicator threshold.
We validate the account address for tax purposes. The account address is considered valid if
the response returned by the Vertex third-party API is greater than the threshold

actionResultMountUrl.description: The mount for action results and datasets

isEmailServiceConfigured.description:
Enabling this would show the "Setup Alerts" tab to users,
through which users can select whether they want to send email notifications on schedule updates.

canvasUrl.description: The url to access the user's default service, specified via {@link ExMachinaUser#session}

userId.description: The id of the current logged-in user

packageName.description: The name of the deployed Ex Machina package
